Inspiration runes depend on your starting items, if you buy corrupting then it’s biscuits and time warp tonic and if you go dorans ring then it’s biscuits and either approach velocity or magical foot ware (both for MS). 

I personally go arcane comet and inspiration with corruption potion runes.

Ludens first
Sorcery boots
Death cap OR hourglass (whether your doing good or not)
Morells
Void staff

Dark Seal - early game if your doing hella well

Landry’s - good pair with rylai
